items.heading: Gallo Pinto
details: Key ingredients: rice, black beans, onion, bell pepper, cilantro
Cook rice and black beans separately, keeping some bean broth.
Saute onion, pepper and garlic until soft.
Combine the rice and beans with the sauteed vegetables and a splash of bean broth.
Fry until the rice takes on color from the beans, then finish with cilantro.

items.heading: Casado
details: Key ingredients: rice, beans, plantain, cabbage salad, meat
Prepare rice and beans as a base.
Fry sweet plantain slices until golden.
Grill or fry a piece of chicken, beef or fish.
Plate everything together with a simple cabbage salad.
